verdict.rationale: USPTO runs its own fees-and-payment page, and the Patent Maintenance Fees Storefront lets users 'view maintenance fees' on the service's own site. That points to self-serve fee disclosure rather than a contact form. No evidence item shows actual statutory dollar amounts or a fee schedule, so the core 'exact amounts' claim is only implied. Missing for 10: a published fee schedule with concrete amounts for filing, application and trademark transactions; evidence that those amounts are readable without logging in; independent or hands-on confirmation.
